fields.description: EEPROM blocks 0..62 (file bytes 0..503). Each block is 8 bytes; all bytes are 0xFF (erased EEPROM state) in the live-captured baseline, i.e. no game data has been written to these blocks yet.
fields.evidence: FUN_08040008 writes exactly one EEPROM block (4 halfwords = 8 bytes from param_2 source) per call; FUN_0803ff44 reads one block (4 halfwords via FUN_0803fec4 DMA len 0x44) into its param_2 buffer; 512-byte media = 64 blocks x 8 bytes, so offsets 0..503 are blocks 0..62. tools/bin_peek.py confirms every byte in 0x000..0x1F8 is 0xFF in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: eeprom_data_blocks_00_62

fields.description: First word of the last EEPROM block (block #63): ASCII tag 'SAV0'.
fields.evidence: Last EEPROM block #63 (file offsets 504..511) is written atomically as one 8-byte block per FUN_08040008; raw bytes at 504..507 are 53 41 56 30 = ASCII 'SAV0' verified in samples/baseline.sav; rev8-logical view shows byte-swapped '0VAS', confirming raw-domain offsets (eeprom_rev8=false).
fields.name: last_block_magic_a
